message: Managed to make it just in time for class to start, and after gathering in the classroom, we all headed to the indoor training grounds.

name: Iori
message: 「Is everyone here？ Wait, where's Keisetsu？」

name: Asahi
message: 「She said she had a business call come in and stepped away.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, then it can't be helped.」
In any case, the main focus from here on out is practical combat training. It doesn't really matter since Keisetsu would just be observing anyway.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, we're finally moving into serious Jindou training. Sorry to have kept you all waiting！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're telling me~! I've been waiting forever. Hurry up and teach us already!」
Ririmu really comes alive when it comes to actual combat.

name: Asahi
message: 「Specifically, what kind of training should we be doing?」

name: Iori
message: 「I've come up with personalized training menus for each of you. I'd like you all to follow those for the time being.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Individual instruction！ That sounds pretty cool！ I bet I'll be many, many times stronger by the time we're done, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don't think it's quite that simple, though~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sensei！ Are you gonna share everyone's individual training contents with the whole group too？ Surely we don't have to go that far, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, of course, it's not like I'm sharing everything completely.」

name: Iori
message: 「However, eventually, the students of the Takamura Class will be doing sparring practice against each other.」

name: Iori
message: 「When that happens, you'll naturally end up sharing your fighting styles and techniques. That shouldn't be a problem, right？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, that makes sense, so that part's totally okay.」
Glad she was convinced.

name: Iori
message: 「Well then, we're a bit behind schedule, but let's make up for it now. Everyone, brace yourselves！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Got it！」
I had everyone disperse, and started by heading over to Setsugekka.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, Setsugekka, your combat style is a combination of hand-to-hand fighting and sword techniques. Your martial arts skills, in particular, are quite remarkable.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Thank you very much! Mishima-ryuu is the strongest, after all♪ I plan on crushing every enemy that stands in my way with these fists!」

name: Iori
message: 「Mishima-ryuu has been honed with the assumption of fighting against swordsmen, but the drawback is that strikes have a shorter range than a blade.」

name: Iori
message: 「So, Setsugekka, your first task is... strictly speaking, physical fitness and strength. It's crucial that you strengthen your body further.」

name: Iori
message: 「Steady, fundamental training is the shortest route. By the time the preliminaries arrive, we should see significant results.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaat, that’s it！？ That’s no different from what we’ve been doing all along！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't you have some kind of special training where you teach me a finishing move and I get strong in a flash？」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, if you have time to dream, start by working on your muscles. Don't worry, muscles never let you down！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, you called it ‘specialized individual training,’ so I was expecting something amazing！」

name: Iori
message: 「Don’t worry, I’ve devised a muscle-training menu that is harder and tougher than anything you’ve done before. I won’t betray your expectations.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Stop meeting my expectations in that specific way！」
She lets her shoulders drop, feeling deflated.

name: Iori
message: 「Of course, that’s not all there is to the training.」

name: Iori
message: 「In close-quarters combat, moment-to-moment judgment is critical. The higher your mental sensitivity, the greater your advantage.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh…！ That’s hitting a sore spot…」
When she isn't in a state of runaway berserking, Setsugekka’s mental sensitivity is below average. However, it’s not as if there’s no room for ingenuity.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, are you familiar with the <d0061>Zone</d>？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The... zone...？ No, I’ve never heard of that.」

name: Iori
message: 「When a person concentrates to the absolute limit, their nerves become so sharp that the movement of objects feels like it’s slowing down.」

name: Iori
message: 「This is a state that could be called the pinnacle of mental control, a mental state often discussed among athletes.」
It feels as if the opponent’s movements are in slow motion. You could say it’s a phenomenon that creates a superhuman sense of time.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, I know what that is! That’s the thing that happens when I’m in top form!」

name: Iori
message: 「We are going to train so you can summon that state at will, exactly at the moment you close the distance.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-at will!？ Don’t be ridiculous! There’s no way I can just aim for that and activate it!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, I don’t expect you to be able to do it immediately.」

name: Iori
message: 「However, sharpening your mental concentration should surely help in suppressing your runaway episodes.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Is that so？」

name: Iori
message: 「You lose control when you feel anger—in other words, when you lack composure. You cannot enter the Zone in a state like that.」

name: Iori
message: 「In short, if you intend to enter the Zone, that inherently means you’ll also be suppressing your runaways.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「O-ohhh…… I see now.」

name: Iori
message: 「Concentration is what matters most. I’ve put together a mountain of exercises that you’re bad at, Setsugekka, so let’s give it our all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I thought you were a kind person, but you’re a sadist！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But…… it is for my own good, isn't it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that’s right. To live up to your desire to become stronger, Setsugekka, I’ve had to be cruel to be kind.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「O-okay. I understand. I’ll give it a try！」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s the spirit! Let’s work hard together!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, next is Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m actually a little bit interested in the custom menus you’ve come up with, Iori-sensei~」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, what kind of things are you going to teach me？」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ll be blunt. You’re strong, Momiji. The rumors that you’re the top candidate for Toujinegi aren’t wrong.」

name: Iori
message: 「Your fighting style, Momiji, focuses on reading your opponent, completely gauging their hand before responding.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s right. You’ve been watching closely, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s why the type you’re bad against would be a high-output power type, where a single blow could be fatal.」

name: Iori
message: 「In this world, no matter how much you hone your reading ability, unexpected things like accidents or pure chance can happen.」

name: Iori
message: 「The possibility of going down from a single unlucky hit—that’s your weakness, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, well, I’m aware of that much myself.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But there’s no countermeasure for that other than further refining my reading, is there?」

name: Iori
message: 「Suppose there were an opponent whose next move you couldn’t read at all. What would be the method to fight someone like that？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you talking about yourself, using Tengen Saimei-ryuu？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that might be close.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s a tough one~ I still haven’t found an answer for how to deal with that.」

name: Iori
message: 「I think your mind just works terrifyingly fast, Momiji. However, there’s a limit to how much one can think through.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s why if you’re facing an opponent you can’t handle by relying on thought, you have to look for another way.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is there really some magical method like that？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, there is. It’s the ‘state of <d0062>Shohou Muga</d>’.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Shohou Muga... I mean, I get the literal meaning, but it’s basically the same thing as Impermanence, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「So, what exactly is this Shohou Muga？」

name: Iori
message: 「Don’t think, feel—unite yourself with the world. That’s what they say.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, so it’s like, ‘Don’t Think, Feeeeeeel！！！’」

name: Momiji
message: 「But not thinking at all is basically the ultimate brain-dead state, right? I can’t imagine fighting in a state like that.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ve actually met someone who can do it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Really？ What was it like？」

name: Iori
message: 「It was incredible. I sparred with them, but my predictions were completely useless. I didn't feel like I could win at all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...You? Really? Hmm, I see.」
Hearing that I couldn't win seemed to have piqued her interest.

name: Iori
message: 「According to that person, Shohou Muga is also known as a state of no-mind, and it is considered the supreme state in all swordsmanship.」

name: Iori
message: 「By completely erasing your killing intent and thoughts, your opponent cannot read your next move. They grow impatient, make a move, and self-destruct.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Erasing your presence while fighting？ Isn't that even more impossible？ But yeah, if you could do that, you'd be the strongest, wouldn't you~」
Erasing one's intent and presence so that nothing can be perceived. I imagine that's the kind of opponent Momiji would hate even thinking about.

name: Momiji
message: 「So, how do you actually fight an opponent like that？」

name: Iori
message: 「I suppose you have no choice but to reach that same state yourself.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So you’re saying my challenge is to master that？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, that’s right. Precisely because you are already becoming so accomplished, Momiji, the next hurdle will be incredibly high.」

name: Momiji
message: 「The person that teacher met, how many years did it take them to reach that state of Shohou Muga？」

name: Iori
message: 「I heard it took them 40 years.」

name: Momiji
message: 「No way, that’s impossible！ The Martial Festival is less than two months away！？」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s alright, Momiji! You can do it!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't throw such unreasonable demands at me!」

name: Iori
message: 「As for the rest, it’s just steady muscle training and building up your endurance. If that’s what you prefer, should I give you something hardcore？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, I’ll take the path of Shohou Muga, please.」
She ran away, didn't she…

name: Momiji
message: 「So？ What should I be training and how？」

name: Iori
message: 「First, zazen.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Za—zazen? That’s so old-fashioned…」

name: Iori
message: 「People call it mindfulness nowadays, too.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Changing the name doesn't change what you’re actually doing!」

name: Iori
message: 「Visualize your mind uniting with the universe and discard all thought. The person I met said this was the best way.」

name: Iori
message: 「So, anyway, zazen it is.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, well… I guess that’s better than hardcore muscle training…」

name: Iori
message: 「I’d personally recommend doing both.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’ll focus on the zazen！」

name: Asahi
message: 「…Finally, it’s finally my turn.」

name: Asahi
message: 「At last, Iori-sensei is sparing some private time for me!」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s not ‘private time,’ it’s private tutoring, okay？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, sorry. Just thinking about receiving direct instruction from Iori-sensei makes my body quiver so much I can’t stop…」

name: Iori
message: 「Right, let’s start by calming you down！」
I have her take a deep breath.

name: Asahi
message: 「Haa, so Iori-sensei, what kind of training should I be doing?」

name: Iori
message: 「Your style, Asahi, is Iai. You’re already plenty proficient in the essentials of Iai: reading your opponent, the ‘anticipatory strike,’ and the ‘reactive strike.’」

name: Iori
message: 「However, you’re often so cautious during matches that you lack a bit of aggressiveness.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes. Specifically, what should I do about that?」

name: Iori
message: 「For one thing, increase your methods of attack. The more variety you have, the more of an advantage you’ll hold.」
It means expanding your repertoire of techniques, not just sticking to Iai. But Asahi doesn't look too thrilled.

name: Asahi
message: 「Since I was little, I've practiced with Iai as my foundation. Of course, I can use other things, but...」

name: Iori
message: 「I know. But as things stand, if you lose the mind game, you'll be at a disadvantage. For example, what about if you were up against Momiji？」

name: Asahi
message: 「That is...」

name: Iori
message: 「And you'd likely have poor synergy against opponents who specialize in unexpected attacks, like Ririmu.」

Iai is a one-hit-kill art, meant to whittle down an opponent's VF with clean hits. It's at a disadvantage against someone like Momiji, who reads several moves ahead, or against illusion-based confusion.

name: Asahi
message: 「I believe if I don't let myself be swayed by the opponent's movements, I have a chance at victory. Is that wrong？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I feel that trying to train in anything other than Iai now would just be a superficial fix. I'm worried about that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I agree. That's why we're not changing your Iai, but changing your strategy instead.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Strategy, you say...？」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, do you think it's possible to attack an opponent without drawing your sword？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Do you mean something like striking with the hilt?」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that's not it. The answer is feints.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Oh, I see... you mean the Tengen Saimei-ryuu, don't you!」
That's right; the Tengen Saimei-ryuu uses a multitude of fakes and feints to 《attack》 the opponent's reads.

name: Iori
message: 「Right now, you're just waiting for the opponent, aiming for a reactive counter.」

name: Iori
message: 「Instead, you should adopt an offensive stance where you 《attack》 your opponent with feints and the like.」

name: Iori
message: 「That is what it means to attack without drawing your sword.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you can acquire that offensive mindset and control the flow of the match, you should be able to master a new strategy.」

name: Asahi
message: 「In other words, manipulate the opponent and secure my own victory. You mean I should be the one to dictate the flow of the match?」

name: Iori
message: 「Exactly！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I see... as expected of Iori-sensei！ You're going to hammer that method into my body starting now, aren't you?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm so happy... If it's special training with Iori-sensei, I'm willing to keep going for hours, for days, until I'm screaming and collapse.」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, I'm not that ruthless, you know？」

name: Iori
message: 「Regardless, it's a difficult task. In the end, you have to cultivate techniques that are good enough to fool even Momiji.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I love deceiving people, so I'll do my best!」

name: Iori
message: 「That only applies within the match, remember? Try not to make a habit of deceiving people in your daily life, okay?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, of course. I promise.」

name: Iori
message: 「...That answer isn't already a fake, is it？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe... well, who knows?」
Man, Asahi is terrifyingly talented...

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, last up is Ririmu. I've come up with a training regimen to make you stronger, just as promised！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yay！ So, what am I doing？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, you possess the incredible Tenju property of Illusions. If you master it, becoming a Toujinegi isn't just a pipe dream.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Duh, obviously♪ My World is Mine is special. Nobody else could ever hope to imitate it.」

name: Iori
message: 「True, but no matter how amazing a technique is, it’s never invincible. I think you're relying too much on your Illusions right now, Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm？ Why shouldn't I rely on them？ They give me a definite advantage, so obviously I'm gonna use 'em.」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course. Just hear me out.」

name: Iori
message: 「When you're not using Illusions, you fight using your own unique school, the Lily Style, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「But once you start using Illusions, your combat becomes quite monotonous.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way, really！？」

name: Iori
message: 「I suspect you're so focused on using your Tenju of Illusions that you're losing track of your own form. That's a huge waste.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa~ I had no idea. I really didn't know.」

name: Iori
message: 「Like I mentioned before, because you allocate your power into your unique Tenju, you fall behind normal swordsmen in terms of attack and defense.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's why, if a power-fighter who dumps everything into offensive Tenju charges at you ready for a mutual knockout, you'll get overpowered.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, yeah, you did say that~」

name: Iori
message: 「The only way for you to counter that is to increase your evasion. Illusions help with that, but they aren't enough on their own.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s where your aforementioned Lily Style comes in.」

name: Iori
message: 「That unique footwork and those steps have high evasion capabilities. Let's make use of them even more—much more.」

name: Iori
message: 「So, I want you to use Yorishiro-kun to train exclusively against past powerhouses, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「In parallel with basic training, you’ll defeat even stronger opponents.」

name: Iori
message: 「You’ll engage in comprehensive matches against not only every generation of Toujinegi but also swordsmen from various schools to hone your predictive skills and improve your evasion.」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you think? Sounds pretty practical, doesn't it?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... doesn’t that sound, like, super dull？」
Ah, she’s making a face like she doesn't want to do it.

name: Iori
message: 「You’ll grow stronger by defeating every formidable foe from the past, you know？ It’s a literal success story on the path to victory！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh! Maybe I actually like the sound of that. I get it, I get it—it’s the story of Flying Lily!」
Oh, she's on board.

name: Iori
message: 「Exactly. I want you to refine your Lily Style within that story and complete Ririmu’s worldview.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, yeah, worldviews！ You get it, Iorin！ You’re really good at getting me motivated, Teach！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「The teachers I’ve had before were never like this, so it’s super fresh. I’m seriously falling for you~♪」

name: Iori
message: 「I-is that so？」
Well, it doesn't feel bad being admired.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, when a gyaru says ‘falling for you,’ it has the light meaning of ‘I like it,’ so please don’t misunderstand.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What！？ Hey, what are you eavesdropping for！？」
Before I knew it, Asahi was nearby, observing us.

name: Iori
message: 「I see, just ‘I like it,’ huh.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, my ‘falling for you’ isn't that light！ It means like, ‘you’re seriously my favorite,’ okay！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, you’re below me in rank, then. I love Iori-sensei from the bottom of my heart.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, please don't say that right to my face...」
I can't help but blush.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Shut it, I’m in the middle of a lesson here！ Go away, you Kijo！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, sorry for the interruption.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Jeez... what is her deal！」

name: Iori
message: 「W-well, I don’t think she meant any harm...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That's pure malice！」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, let's get Yorishiro-kun set up. I've already got a list of opponents ready.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm already looking forward to seeing how Lily Style grows！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Okay！ I'm gonna show off my worldview~」
